card.title: TOYAMA REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 69th Infantry Regiment Toyama was a regiment of the 109th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army which was active from 1937 to 1945. The division was sent to China in 1937 where it saw combat but was later assigned to garrison duty in the Shanxi province. The 109th Division was dissolved in 1939 but reformed in 1944 and assigned to the 31st Army. The bulk of the division was assigned to garrison duty on the volcanic islands of Iwo Jima and Chichi Jima and would be wiped out in the Battle of Iwo Jima in 1945.
